# Shopify GA4 + GTM Analytics Demo Store

> A Shopify Dawn-fork demonstrating a production-grade analytics tracking layer
> with GA4 event tracking, Google Tag Manager, Facebook Pixel/CAPI dual-firing,
> and structured data for SEO and AI discoverability.

## About this store

This Shopify theme fork demonstrates how to implement a complete analytics
layer on a Shopify storefront. It is intended as a technical portfolio project
and reference implementation.

## Products

All products in this store are demo items for analytics testing purposes.
Purchases do not fulfill real orders.

## Analytics implementation

### Events tracked

| Event | Trigger | Layer |
|-------|---------|-------|
| view_item | Product page load | GTM dataLayer (server-rendered) |
| add_to_cart | ATC button click | GTM dataLayer + Facebook Pixel + CAPI |
| remove_from_cart | Cart remove link | GTM dataLayer |
| view_cart | Cart drawer open / cart page | GTM dataLayer |
| begin_checkout | Checkout button | GTM dataLayer + Facebook Pixel |
| purchase | Order status page | GTM dataLayer + Facebook CAPI |
| select_item | Product card click | GTM dataLayer |

### Structured data

Every product page includes:
- `Product` JSON-LD schema (offers per variant, aggregate rating)
- Open Graph meta tags

### Technology

- Shopify Dawn theme fork
- Google Tag Manager
- GA4 (via GTM)
- Facebook Pixel (browser) + Conversions API (server-side)
- JSON-LD / schema.org
- Shopify Liquid, JavaScript

GitHub: https://github.com/danh-le/shopify-ga4-gtm-analytics
